newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait congratulates Clinton on victory.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait congratulates Clinton on victory.

text.p: Kuwait on Wednesday congratulated Bill Clinton on his re-election as President of the United States.
Official media said Kuwait Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah sent a message to Clinton congratulating him on his election victory.
Clinton visited Kuwait in 1994 to show Washington's support after Iraq massed troops along its borders.
Kuwait often expresses gratitude for Washington's leading role in the 1991 Gulf War, under former Republican president George Bush, to free it of a seven-month Iraqi occupation.
There are still some 4,500 U.S. soldiers in Kuwait.
